name: Bond market volatility
summary: MOVE index of Treasury volatility at 102 on 17 Nov, above the 100 Watch line; US 10-year yield 5.10%
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility closed near 102 on 17 Nov, 10% higher on the week and above the 100 Watch line (Yahoo Finance). The US 10-year yield ended near 5.10%, about 1bp lower over the month and well inside the 40bp monthly move line. Weak 10- and 30-year auctions on 10 and 12 Nov had already put Treasury demand in focus.
for_you: Bond-market swings feed through to mortgage and borrowing costs over time. This describes market conditions only.
rubric_hit: MOVE 98.2 has not yet cleared the 90 exit line, so Watch holds

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — ICE BofAML MOVE Index (^MOVE)

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
